z-m-11-01.title: Huwandu hukuru kupfuura nhamba yevadzidzi. Tebhura yakaipa here?
z-m-11-01.topic: Huwandu hwetebhura nenhamba yevanhu vakabvunzwa (data umo munhu mumwe akaisa mamaki kupfuura kamwe)
z-m-11-01.goal: Kana huwandu hwose mutebhura hwakasiyana nenhamba yevadzidzi vakabvunzwa, usapedza uchiti tebhura yakaipa, asi utaure zvimwe zvaunoda kuziva senzira yekubvunza, uye uchinje kutonga kwako nehumwe ruzivo rutsva.
z-m-11-01.material:
Kirasi 3 yegiredhi 4 ine vadzidzi 28. Vakabvunza 'nzvimbo yavanoda kuenda kwairi parwendo rwechikoro' ndokugadzira tebhura iri pazasi. Nhamba dziri mutebhura inhamba yevadzidzi vakaisa ○ panzvimbo iyoyo.

| Nzvimbo | Muzinda wezvinyorwa | Zoo | Science center | Amusement park | Huwandu |
| Vadzidzi (nhamba yevanhu) | 12 | 10 | 9 | 7 | 38 |

Jia akati, "Huwandu i38 asi kirasi yedu ine vadzidzi 28. Tebhura yakaipa!" (Tebhura yakanyorwa nemashoko, saka hapana mufananidzo. Mitsara yetebhura, kubva pamusoro, inzvimbo nenhamba yevadzidzi.)
z-m-11-01.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa zvinogona nezvisingagoni kutaurwa netebhura oga
z-m-11-01.thinking.1: Kuzvitaurira iwe amene kuti ruzivo rupi rwunoda kuwedzerwa
z-m-11-01.thinking.2: Kugadzirisa kutonga nekuvimba kwako pese painobuda ruzivo rutsva
z-m-11-01.prereq.0: Kuverenga nhamba yechinhu chimwe nechimwe mutebhura nekuwedzera (ukuru hwemagiredhi 3-4)
z-m-11-01.prereq.1: Kuti mukubvunza kune nyaya umo 'munhu mumwe anosarudza chinhu chimwe chete' nenyaya umo 'munhu mumwe anosarudza zvinhu zvakawanda'
z-m-11-01.s.s1.prompt: Data yakawanda inobuda chimwe chidimbu panguva. Sarudza kufunga kwako nguva imwe neimwe.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora huwandu nenhamba yevadzidzi padivi nedivi uye utange watarisa kuti dzakasiyana sei.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.hint.1: Uchishandisa muenzaniso mudiki (vadzidzi 3), verenga mamaki mangani akawandisa pane vadzidzi kana munhu mumwe akaisa mamaki panzvimbo mbiri.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Zvinozivikanwa zvino itebhura chete nenhamba yevadzidzi (28). Pepa rekubvunza harisati ratarwa.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti tebhura iyi yakaipa here?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Huwandu hwe38 hunogona kuva nokuda kwenzira yekubvunza, kana nokuti mudzidzi mumwe chete akaverengwa kaviri paaiverengwa. Unogona kuziva chete nekutarisa pepa rekubvunza.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Huwandu hwakasiyana nenhamba yevadzidzi, saka tebhura yakaverengwa zvisirizvo
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wapomera nzira yekuverenga nokuti huwandu hwakasiyana nenhamba yevadzidzi. Tanga wafunga kuti izvi zvinogona kuitika zvichienderana nenzira yekubvunza.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kusvikira tatarisa pepa rekubvunza, hatigoni kuziva kana tebhura yakaipa
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakamira panzvimbo yakarurama. Uku kufunga kwakarangarira kuti netebhura imwe chete, huwandu hunogona kusiyana zvichienderana nenzira yekubvunza.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Kana huwandu huri hukuru kupfuura nhamba yevadzidzi, tebhura yakarurama nguva dzose
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Zvakapesana, wakavimba nekukurumidza. Chikonzero chekuti huwandu huri hukuru chingava kukanganisa kuverenga, saka unofanira kuongorora.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Pepa rekubvunza raiti, "Isa ○ panzvimbo dzaunoda kuenda. Unogona kusarudza dzakawanda kusvika mbiri." Mudzidzisi akatanga kuronga mapepa akati vadzidzi vose 28 vakaisa ○ panzvimbo imwe chete kana kupfuura.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana, sezvakataurwa nemudzidzisi, munhu wose akaisa maki panzvimbo imwe kana kupfuura uye pazvikuru mbiri, mamaki 38 akaenzana nevadzidzi 28 pamwe nenhamba yevadzidzi vakasarudza nzvimbo mbiri. Saka vadzidzi 10 vakasarudza nzvimbo mbiri.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaita zvakanaka kuwana kuti huwandu hwunowanikwa nekubvisa nhamba yevadzidzi, 28, pamamaki e○, 38, ihuwandu hwemamaki akaitwa 'kamwe kumwe'.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Zvinoratidza kuti wakafunga hafu ye28. Funga kuti musiyano pakati pemamaki 38 nevadzidzi 28 unorevei.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Zvinoratidza kuti wakafunga hafu ye38. Verenga mamaki mangani akawandisa pane vadzidzi kana munhu mumwe asarudza nzvimbo mbiri.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana mudzidzisi akaongorora mapepa ekubvunza zvakare kubva pakutanga, chirevo chekutanga chakanga chakaipa. Vadzidzi 4 havana kuisa ○ panzvimbo chero ipi, uye vamwe 24 vakaisa ○ panzvimbo imwe kana mbiri.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zvino, vadzidzi vangani vakaisa ○ panzvimbo mbiri?
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Pakati pevadzidzi 24, kana 10 vakasarudza nzvimbo imwe chete uye 14 vakasarudza nzvimbo mbiri, huwandu hwemamaki i10+28=38. Kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya, mhinduro inochinja kunyange netebhura imwe chete.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakavhiringidza nhamba yevadzidzi vasina kuisa maki panzvimbo chero ipi nenhamba yevadzidzi vakaisa maki panzvimbo mbiri. Ava vanhu vakasiyana.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatakura mhinduro yematanho ekutanga sezvayakanga yakaita. Ongorora zvakare kana vadzidzi 4 vawakangoziva vanofanira kupinda mukuverenga.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Uku kufunga kwakashanda zvakare neruzivo rutsva. Wakawana nyaya umo vadzidzi 24 vanosarudza nzvimbo imwe kana mbiri uye huwandu hwemamaki hunova 38.
z-m-11-01.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga, pfungwa yako yakanga padhuze nokuti 'tebhura yakaipa' here kana 'hatigoni kuziva'? Pepa rekubvunza neruzivo rwevadzidzi 4 vasina kupindura zvakachinja chii? Kana pachine zvausingazivi, ndezvipi?
z-m-11-01.s.s2.prompt: Unoziva kuti pepa rekubvunza raiti 'kusvika panzvimbo mbiri'. Sarudza zvose zvaunogona kutaura zvakanaka uchishandisa nhamba dziri mutebhura iyi nezviri papepa rekubvunza chete.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira mudzidzi mumwe akaisa ○ panzvimbo mbiri, muzinda wezvinyorwa nezoo. Mudzidzi iyeye anoenda mubhokisi ripi?

z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.b: Bhokisi rimwe retebhura inhamba yevadzidzi vakaisa ○ panzvimbo iyoyo, saka unogona kuriverenga nenzira iyi.

z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.c: 38 inhamba yenguva dzakaitwa ○. Mudzidzi mumwe anogona kunge akaita kaviri, saka hausi kufanira kuiverenga senhamba yevadzidzi.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.d: Vadzidzi 12 vakasarudza muzinda wezvinyorwa nevadzidzi 10 vakasarudza zoo vadzidzi vakasiyana
z-m-11-01.s.s2.r.d: Waigona kusarudza nzvimbo mbiri, saka mudzidzi mumwe chete aigona kuva mumapoka ose maviri.
z-m-11-01.s.s2.o.e: Vadzidzi vakasarudza science center vanodarika vakasarudza amusement park ne2

z-m-11-01.s.s3.model.0: Huwandu hukuru hahusi kureva kuti yakaipa pakarepo. Kana kubvunza kwakabvumira munhu wese kuisa ○ panzvimbo mbiri kana kupfuura, huwandu hunogona kuva hukuru kupfuura nhamba yevadzidzi. Ngatitange taongorora papepa rekubvunza kuti ungasarudza nzvimbo dzakawanda sei.

z-m-11-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakataurawo kuti kuongorora, kunze kwemhinduro dzakawanda, huwandu hwevanhu vakapindura nenzira yekuverenga.
z-m-11-01.s.s3.model.2: Pfungwa yaJia haina kururama. Tebhura yakarurama. Kana unogona kusarudza nzvimbo dzakawanda, huwandu hunogona kuva hukuru kupfuura nhamba yevadzidzi, saka ngationgorore pepa rekubvunza.

z-m-11-02.title: Nzira yaMinseo yekuverenga pictograph: chii chinoita seicho chisina kunaka?
z-m-11-02.goal: Ratidza nemuenzaniso unopokana kuti mupictograph umo mifananidzo yemaukuru akasiyana ine makosha akasiyana, kuenzanisa nekuverenga mifananidzo chete kunogona kukanganisa, uye utaure mamiriro umo kuenzanisa nekuverenga kwakanaka.
z-m-11-02.material:
Nhamba yemabhureki anotengeswa pazuva rimwe pamabheka mana emuvakidzani inoratidzwa mupictograph. Mufananidzo mumwe mukuru webhureki unomirira mabhureki 10, uye mufananidzo mumwe mudiki webhureki unomirira bhureki 1. Hapana mufananidzo, saka yakanyorwa nemashoko.

| Bheka | Mifananidzo mikuru yebhureki | Mifananidzo midiki yebhureki |
| 가 | 3 | 4 |
| 나 | 2 | 9 |
| 다 | 4 | 0 |
| 라 | 3 | 7 |

Minseo akaverenga graph iyi ndokuipfupisa mumitsara mitanhatu iri pazasi.

Bheka 나 rine mifananidzo 11 asi rakatengesa 29, uye Bheka 다 rine mifananidzo 4 chete asi, nokuti mifananidzo mikuru, rakatengesa 40, zvakawanda zvikuru.

Kana maukuru akasanganiswa uye divi rimwe rine mifananidzo mikuru yakawanda richiti rimwe rine midiki yakawanda, unofanira kuwana makosha ndokuenzanisa.

z-m-11-08.title: Zuva rakatanga nokupera zvakafanana: tinogona kutaura kuti hapana shanduko here?
z-m-11-08.topic: Kuverenga shanduko dziri pakati pe line graph kana kutanga nokupera zvakafanana
z-m-11-08.goal: Gadzira muenzaniso unopesana unoratidza kuti kunyange kana kukosha kwokutanga nokupera kwakafanana, zvinogona kunge zvakachinja pakati, uye usiyanise zvinogona nezvisingagoni kuzikanwa kubva pagraph.
z-m-11-08.material:
Tembiricha yepachirabhu yakayerwa maawa 3 ega ega ikaratidzwa muline graph. (Hapana mufananidzo. Kukosha kwamapoinzi ndokunotevera.)

| Nguva | 9 a.m. | 12 masikati | 3 p.m. | 6 p.m. |
| Tembiricha (℃) | 14 | 19 | 21 | 14 |

Minjun akati, "Tembiricha ye 9 a.m. ne 6 p.m. yakafanana, 14℃, saka tembiricha yepachirabhu haina kuchinja zuva rose iroro."

z-m-11-03.title: Mikaka yemakatoni egraph yemabara: chiratidzo chimwe chinofanira kuva chakakura sei?
z-m-11-03.topic: Kusarudza ukuru hwechiratidzo chimwe pachiyero chakamira chegraph yemabara
z-m-11-03.goal: Wana nzira dzakasiyana dzekusarudza ukuru hwechiratidzo chimwe chechiyero chakamira kuti makosha edata awire chaizvo pamitsara yechiyero uye akodzere papepa, uye utaure kuti nzira imwe neimwe inowanikwa nyore kuverenga mune rimwe divi.
z-m-11-03.material:
Tinoda kuratidza nhamba yemakatoni emukaka akaunganidzwa nemapoka mana egiredhi 4 muchikoro chedu mugraph yemabara.

| Boka | Sun | Moon | Star | Forest |
| Makatoni emukaka (nhamba) | 24 | 36 | 60 | 48 |

Mitemo yepepa regraph:
- Chiyero chakamira chinotangira pa0 ndokukwira. Rodza nhamba yemakatoni anomirirwa nemutsara umwe wechiyero se u (nhamba yechisikigo), uye nhamba yezviratidzo zvechiyero chakamira se n.
- Nokuda kweukuru hwepepa, n i5 kana kupfuura uye i12 kana shoma.
- Kukosha kukuru (60) kunofanira kupinda mugraph. Ndiko kuti, chiyero chepamusoro chinofanira kuva 60 kana kupfuura.
- Muhomwe webara rega rega unofanira kugara chaizvo pamutsara wechiyero kuti kukosha kuverengwe chaizvo.
z-m-11-03.prereq.0: Kuverenga scale ye bar graph nekudhirowa mabhawa (nhanho yeGrade 3)
z-m-11-03.s.s1.prompt: Minho akati achaita chiratidzo chimwe chete kuva makatoni 10 uye adhirowe zviratidzo zvakamira 6. (Scale yepamusoro ndi60.) Dambudziko riri papi neplan iyi?
z-m-11-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa mamiriro akanyorwa mumitemo rimwe nerimwe neplan yaMinho (10, zviratidzo 6).
z-m-11-03.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa imwe imwe kana 24, 36, ne48 dziri pamitsara ye scale inokwira ne10.
z-m-11-03.s.s1.o.a: Bhawa refu zvikuru (60) rinoenda kunze kwepepa uye harikwani mu graph
z-m-11-03.s.s1.r.a: 10×6=60, saka 60 inobata scale yepamusoro chaizvo. Unogona kuziva izvozvo nekutarisa plan nenhamba.
z-m-11-03.s.s1.o.b: Scale haitangi pa0, saka haugoni kuverenga makosha kubva pakukwirira kwemabhawa
z-m-11-03.s.s1.r.b: Plan iyi inotangawo pa0. Tarisa plan nemamiriro ari mumitemo rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-11-03.s.s1.o.c: Pane zviratidzo zvakamira 6 chete, saka huwandu hwezviratidzo hushoma zvichienzaniswa nemitemo
z-m-11-03.s.s1.r.c: Mitemo inoti huwandu hwezviratidzo hunofanira kuva 5 kana kupfuura chete. Zviratidzo 6 zviri mukati memamiriro.
z-m-11-03.s.s1.o.d: Magumo emabhawa e24, 36, ne48 ari pakati pemitsara ye scale
z-m-11-03.s.s1.r.d: Wakawana zvakarurama. Kana scale iri 10, 20, 30, ..., saka 24 iri pakati pe20 ne30.
z-m-11-03.s.s1.explain: 10×6=60, saka inokwana papepa uye huwandu hwezviratidzo huri mukati memamiriro, asi 24 iri pakati pe20 ne30, 36 pakati pe30 ne40, uye 48 pakati pe40 ne50. Saka hadziri chaizvo pamitsara ye scale.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mapurani 2 e scale anogutsa mitemo yose, ane saizi dze scale dzakasiyana. (Huwandu hwemakatoni pachiratidzo chimwe u nehuwandu hwezviratidzo zvakamira n. Kana saizi ye scale u yakasiyana, iverenge seplan yakasiyana.)
z-m-11-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza saizi yechiratidzo chimwe, uye utarise kana 24, 36, 48, ne60 imwe neimwe iri chaizvo pamitsara ye scale inokwira nesaizi iyoyo. Kana kukosha kupi nekupi kuri pakati pemitsara ye scale, saizi iyoyo haishande.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana ukawana saizi apo makosha ose mana ari pamitsara ye scale, verenga kuti unoda zviratidzo zvingani kusvika ku60 uye utarise kuti huri mukati memamiriro ehuwandu hwezviratidzo.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.ok.c1: u ndi natural number uye n inobva ku5 kusvika ku12.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.fail.c1: u inofanira kuva natural number uye n inofanira kubva ku5 kusvika ku12.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Scale yepamusoro ndi60 kana kupfuura, saka bhawa re60 rinokwana.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Scale yepamusoro (u×n) iri pasi pe60, saka bhawa refu zvikuru rinoenda kunze kwepepa.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Magumo emabhawa ose mana ari chaizvo pamitsara ye scale.
z-m-11-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Gumo rebhawa rimwe riri pakati pemitsara ye scale, saka zvakaoma kuverenga kukosha chaizvo.

z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.c: Bhuku kuva pakati pesarudzo hakuiti kuti ongororo ive yakanganisa. Funga kana sarudzo dzichichinjana kana kusiya chimwe.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.o.d: Mudzidzi anoda kuverenga mabhuku enhoroondo kana emadetembo haana sarudzo yokusarudza
z-m-11-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakawana kuti pane vadzidzi vanoda rudzi rusiri paongororo. Vakapindura, asi vanogona kuva vasingagoni kuisa pfungwa dzavo.
z-m-11-07.s.s1.explain: Kana sarudzo dzichichinjana, vadzidzi vane pfungwa imwe chete vanogona kuenda mumabhokisi akasiyana, uye kana marudzi mamwe asipo, vadzidzi ivavo vanofanira kuzvisunga kusarudza bhokisi riri pedyo. Huwandu hukuru hwesarudzo kana rudzi rumwe kusanganisirwa hakusi dambudziko.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.prompt: Junho akataura seizvi achinge aona mhedzisiro yeongororo. Mutsetse upi unoshamisa? (Nhamba dzemitsetse dzinotanga pa 1.)
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kana, pakati pevadzidzi 5 vakasarudza mabhuku enyaya, pangava nevadzidzi vanoda mabhuku ngano zvakare.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.hint.1: Pamutsetse wega wega, tarisa 'kana mudzidzi mumwe chete aigona kuenda kaviri kana uchiwedzera kana kuenzanisa mabhokisi'.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.0: 1. Munhu mumwe nomumwe akasarudza imwe chete, saka 27, huwandu hwenhamba dzose dziri patafura, ihuwandu hwevadzidzi vakapindura.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.1: 2. Mabhuku emakomiki, nevadzidzi 9, ibhokisi rakasarudzwa kazhinji zvikuru.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.2: 3. 3 yenhoroondo dzehupenyu ne 2 yemabhuku esainzi ivadzidzi vakasiyana, saka pamwe chete ndi 5.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.3: 4. Vadzidzi 8 vakasarudza mabhuku ngano, saka vadzidzi 8 chete ndivo vanoda mabhuku ngano.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.line.4: 5. Vadzidzi vakasarudza mabhuku emakomiki vari 1 vakawanda kupfuura vadzidzi vakasarudza mabhuku ngano.
z-m-11-07.s.s2.explain: Mutsetse 4 unoshamisa. Pakati pevadzidzi 5 vakasarudza mabhuku enyaya, pangava nevadzidzi vanodawo mabhuku ngano, saka vadzidzi vanopfuura 8 vanogona kuda mabhuku ngano. Sezvo munhu mumwe nomumwe akasarudza imwe chete, unogona kubatanidza mabhokisi sepamitsetse 1 ne 3.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.prompt: Gadzira patsva sarudzo dzeongororo. Nyora 5 kana shoma, dzigadzire kuti dzisachinjana kuti munhu mumwe nomumwe asarudze imwe chete, uye ita kuti pave nenzvimbo yomudzidzi wose yokusarudza. Wobva wanyora chikonzero chawakaparadzanisa nacho mumashoko mamwe chete kana maviri.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza mutemo mumwe wokuparadzanisa mabhuku (semuenzaniso, zvirimo kana chimiro), uye unyore sarudzo nomutemo uyu.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.hint.1: Funga mazita matatu emabhuku uye utarise rimwe nerimwe kuti rinoenda chaizvo musarudzo imwe chete here.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakaedza here nemienzaniso kana pane bhuku rinokodzera sarudzo mbiri kana kupfuura panguva imwe chete?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Pane nzvimbo here yomudzidzi anoda kuverenga mabhuku enhoroondo kana emadetembo yokusarudza?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kana wakawedzera bhokisi rakaita se 'mamwe mabhuku', wakafunga here kuti bhokisi iri rinogona kuva guru zvikuru?
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.0: Sarudzo: mabhuku enyaya (anosanganisira mabhuku ngano), mabhuku emakomiki, mabhuku esainzi, nhoroondo nenhoroondo dzehupenyu, mamwe mabhuku. Mabhuku ngano nemabhuku enyaya anochinjana, saka ndakaabatanidza kuva rimwe, uye ndakawedzera 'mamwe mabhuku' kuti vadzidzi vanoda kuverenga mabhuku asingakodzeri kwakamwe vaasarudze.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.model.1: Sarudzo: manovhero, mabhuku emakomiki, mabhuku ruzivo (sainzi nenhoroondo), mabhuku emadetembo, nhoroondo dzehupenyu. Ndakaaparadzanisa nezvirimo zvemabhuku kuti bhuku risambopfuura mabhokisi maviri. Sezvo pasina mabhokisi anochinjana, ndinofunga vadzidzi vachasarudza bhokisi rimwe chete.
z-m-11-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Yakaparadzanisa nemutemo wezvirimo uye yakatarisa kuti hazvichinjani, asi haina kutaura nezve 'kusiya'.
